description: This file defines a report class for Employee Hours Utilization based on timesheets, including data processing, validation, and chart generation.

classes.name: EmployeeHoursReport
classes.description: Class for generating Employee Hours Utilization Report based on timesheet data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that creates and runs the EmployeeHoursReport.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report with filters and prepares date range.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that the from_date is before to_date.

methods.name: validate_standard_working_hours
methods.description: Ensures standard working hours are set in HR Settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Generates report columns, data, summary, and chart.

methods.name: generate_data
methods.description: Generates report data by processing time logs and calculating utilization.

methods.name: filter_stats_by_department
methods.description: Filters employee stats by department if specified.

methods.name: generate_filtered_time_logs
methods.description: Fetches filtered time logs from the database.

methods.name: generate_stats_by_employee
methods.description: Aggregates hours per employee from filtered logs.

methods.name: set_employee_department_and_name
methods.description: Retrieves employee name and department for each employee.

methods.name: calculate_utilizations
methods.description: Calculates total, untracked hours and utilization percentages.

methods.name: generate_report_summary
methods.description: Creates summary metrics like average utilization.
